minor.issue: Flaky when run in full suite (AI assessment did not leave 'assessing' before timeout); passes in isolation. Consider raising the wait or using the same wait helper as test_p11.

ui_bugs.issue: Offline navigation to a never-cached job id still shows generic 'FAILED TO LOAD JOB DATA' / RETRY instead of the required 'NOT AVAILABLE OFFLINE. OPEN THIS JOB ONCE WHILE CONNECTED.'. The fix put in iter12 reads (q.error as Error)?.message || 'Failed to load job data' at line 25 — so q.error is either null, or its message is falsy, meaning React Query is NOT holding the offline-sentinel Error thrown by offlineCache.ts:34. Likely cause: with networkMode:'offlineFirst' and queries.retry returning false on e.offline, when fetch throws immediately and cached() throws the sentinel, React Query reports state where !q.data triggers before isError flips (or error gets stripped). Needs runtime verification (see RCA for fix suggestions).

action_items: Apply the same offline-sentinel handling to /app/frontend/app/project/[id].tsx (staff screen) which currently hard-codes 'Failed to load project' — if a staff user ever loses connection to a never-opened project, they will also see a wrong message.

Investigate why q.error.message does not reach the render for a thrown sentinel. Add a temporary console.log in app/job/[id].tsx right before returning the error branch to print q.status / q.fetchStatus / q.error — I expect q.status==='error' and q.error.offline===true. If instead q.status==='pending' with isLoading===false, that means offlineFirst paused the retry and we need to also catch !q.data when fetchStatus==='paused'.

Optional: harden /app/frontend/src/utils/storage/index.web.ts round-trip. AsyncStorage on web stores JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify({at,d})) — a double-stringified blob — because retrieve() does only one JSON.parse. offlineCache.ts:35 compensates with a second JSON.parse(String(raw)).d, which is fragile. Either make retrieve() parse-twice for the oc:* namespace or drop the inner JSON.parse in offlineCache.ts after fixing retrieve to a single pass. Current code happens to work (DOUBLE-PARSE SIM returned parse_succeeded=true) but is a latent bug.

Device-only (NOT tested on web preview): native camera + GPS stamping, airplane-mode queueing, backgrounding/foreground AppState rescue, Picture-in-Picture video, gallery EXIF date parsing on iOS/Android.
critical_code_review_comments: query-client.ts retry policy correctly skips offline-sentinel (!e?.offline) and 4xx (e.status 400-499) — verified end-to-end: offline never-opened does NOT retry (observed) and online 404 for fake id shows PROJECT NOT FOUND immediately without retry.
networkMode: 'offlineFirst' lets offline cached job A still render after an SPA re-nav while offline — the useQuery.queryFn runs cached() even without connection and the stored data is served.

/app/frontend/app/project/[id].tsx (staff screen) uses a hard-coded 'Failed to load project' message in its ErrorBlock, so it will mis-report both offline and non-404 server errors to employees — mirror the installer fix here too.
offlineCache.ts correctly scopes keys per-user (k = oc:{uid}:...) and drops cache on 403/404 after the server answers.

AsyncStorage web adapter double-stringifies values; code works via a compensating JSON.parse(String(raw)).d in cached() — but if the web adapter is ever fixed to single-encode, cached() will silently fail. Fix one layer, document the other.
